Slots for [brg_team-hero]. Declared beside the fragment so a slot and its {token} ship in one commit. Generated into website/acf/ by `python3 kit/build-acf.py`; never hand-edit an acf.json. Slot names are underscore-only. Defaults are esc_html'd, so write literal characters, never `&` or `—`. THE

IS NOT WIRED: Whether the hero display headline should be an ACF field at all is Sean's design gate and is still open as of 2026-08-13 — Conti recommended wiring it, but a peer cannot grant a call the MANIFESTO puts at Sean's gate. THE SUB IS SPLIT AROUND ITS INLINE , not carried by one field. The highlighted word is a pink inline . Same technique as community-give's lede and community-stats' label lines: keep the structural markup in the fragment and slot the text around it, so no field ever has to hold HTML. An `html`/wysiwyg slot would return

-wrapped content nested inside

. The space before the lives in the MARKUP because ACF trims on save — a default ending in a trailing space would silently lose it and the words would run together.

sub_1.label: Sub copy — before the pink word
sub_1.doc: Opening clause. The space before the pink word is in the markup, so no trailing space here.
sub_1.default: We're operators, leaders, community builders — and yes, we all have strong opinions about

sub_highlight.label: Sub copy — the pink word
sub_highlight.doc: Rendered in brand pink, mid-sentence. One word or a very short phrase.

sub_2.label: Sub copy — after the pink word
sub_2.doc: The rest of the sentence. Starts immediately after the pink word with no space, so begin with the punctuation.
sub_2.default: . This is the team behind the brands.
